name: Hashabiah
title: Levite and leader in God's service
summary: Hashabiah was a Levite who played an important role in the post-exilic period. He is mentioned in several contexts in the books of Ezra and Nehemiah as a leader among the Levites, and actively participated in the rebuilding of Jerusalem and in worship at the temple. He was among those who sealed the covenant with God under Nehemiah.

keyEvents.title: Leader among the Levites at the Ahava Canal
keyEvents.description: Hashabiah was among the Levites gathered at the Ahava Canal before the journey back to Jerusalem under Ezra's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Entrusted with the temple treasures
keyEvents.description: Ezra entrusted Hashabiah and other Levites with the silver, gold, and vessels that were to be brought to the temple in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Sealed the covenant with God
keyEvents.description: Hashabiah was among the Levites who put their seal on the covenant to follow God's law under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Leader over half of the Keilah district
keyEvents.description: Hashabiah served as leader over half of the Keilah district and participated in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Service in the temple
keyEvents.description: Hashabiah is mentioned among the Levitical leaders who were responsible for the music and service in God's house after returning from exile.

keyEvents.title: Participation in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Hashabiah was among the Levitical leaders who took part in the great celebration at the dedication of the rebuilt city wall in Jerusalem.
